Advanced Response-Surface Experimental Designs

advanced-experimental-designs.Rd

Generate, import, and audit response-surface designs for Bayesian planning and analysis. Version 1.1.0 includes central composite, Box-Behnken, and transparent exact candidate-set A-, D-, I-, and G-optimal searches.

bayes_ccd(factors, center_points = 5L,
  type = c("circumscribed", "face_centered", "inscribed"),
  alpha = "rotatable", bounds = NULL, randomize = FALSE,
  seed = 20260826)

bayes_box_behnken(factors, center_points = 3L, bounds = NULL,
  randomize = FALSE, seed = 20260826)

bayes_optimal_design(factors, n_runs, criterion = c("D", "A", "I", "G"),
  candidate_levels = c(-1, 0, 1),
  model = c("second_order", "first_order"), region = NULL,
  iterations = 30L, seed = 20260826)

bayes_rsm_import(x, factors = NULL, design_name = "custom")

bayes_rsm_audit(design,
  model = c("second_order", "first_order", "pseudoquadratic"),
  powers = 0.5, region = NULL, grid_n = 7L)

Arguments

factors

Factor names or a positive integer number of factors.

center_points

Number of replicated center runs.

type

Central-composite geometry.

alpha

Rotatable axial distance or a positive numeric value.

bounds

Optional natural-scale factor bounds.

randomize

Whether to randomize the run order.

seed

Random seed for randomized or search operations.

n_runs

Number of candidate points retained in an optimal design.

criterion

A-, D-, I-, or G-optimality criterion.

candidate_levels

Numeric levels used to create a candidate grid.

model

First-order, second-order, or pseudoquadratic design basis.

region

Prediction region, as named bounds or explicit points.

iterations

Maximum exchange-search sweeps.

x

External design object, data frame, or matrix.

design_name

Descriptive label for an imported design.

design

A response-surface design or design matrix.

powers

Fractional powers used by pseudoquadratic models.

grid_n

Integration-grid resolution per factor.

Value

Design constructors return a bayes_rsm_design; bayes_rsm_audit() returns a bayes_rsm_audit containing estimability, conditioning, term correlation, VIF, prediction-variance, FDS, VDG, approximate rotatability, and A/D/I/G information summaries.

Details

Generated CCDs always retain explicit coded columns. Natural-scale bounds, when supplied, are an additional representation and do not replace the coded geometry used for design auditing. The optimal-design search is a reproducible base-R exchange implementation intended for transparent teaching and moderate candidate sets. Specialist design software can be compared separately.

Examples

ccd <- bayes_ccd(c("N", "P"), center_points = 5)
bayes_rsm_audit(ccd)
#> <bayes_rsm_audit>
#>   Status: PASS
#>   Runs / terms / rank: 13 / 6 / 6
#>   Scaled condition number: 1.1402
#>   Integrated prediction variance: 0.28951
#>   Approximate rotatability score: 0.9977
bayes_box_behnken(c("N", "P", "K"))
#> <bayes_rsm_design>
#>   Type: box_behnken
#>   Runs: 15
#>   Factors: coded_N, coded_P, coded_K
bayes_optimal_design(c("x1", "x2"), 9, criterion = "D")
#> <bayes_rsm_design>
#>   Type: d_optimal
#>   Runs: 9
#>   Factors: x1, x2
